release_notes.snippet: 🪵 `st.logout` will log the user out of their identity provider if the server metadata includes `end_session_endpoint` (#11901, #11900). Thanks, velochy!

release_notes.title: Streamlit 0.87.0 - Highlights
release_notes.heading: Highlights
release_notes.snippet: 🔢 Introducing `st.metric`, an API for displaying KPIs. Check out the demo app showcasing the functionality.

release_notes.title: Streamlit 1.39.0 - Other Changes
release_notes.heading: Bug fix
release_notes.snippet: 🦂 Bug fix: Streamlit uses `example.com` instead of `test.com` in a health check to avoid unnecessary warnings (#9371). Thanks, wyattscarpenter!
